    Subobjects and quotients at one semistable weight #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.Weight.isSemistable_iff_quotients {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] {θ : Weight C} (X : C) :
    θ.IsSemistable X ↔ θ.eval X = 0 ∧ ∀ {Q : C} (q : X ⟶ Q) [CategoryTheory.Epi q], 0 ≤ θ.eval Q

    Semistability can also be tested by nonnegative weight on all quotients.
